name: pelyar
description: A dashboard and control panel docked beside the transcript: model and effort, the context meter, a pomodoro, Spotify or Apple Music, your pull requests on GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket, your tickets in Jira, Linear, GitHub and GitLab, the other Claude sessions, your todo list and the session commands.

title.title: Panel title
title.description: The panel's title and footer button. Empty: "Pelyar".

background.title: Panel background
background.description: A colour for the whole panel: a shade off a dark background, or off white with a light theme. none: the default look.

showTicket.title: Ticket row
showTicket.description: Show the current branch and the ticket its name carries (PROJ-12 in Jira or Linear, or 123-fix-login on GitHub or GitLab), under the header.

showContext.title: Context meter
showContext.description: The context fill, with a nudge at 70% and 85% (toasted only when no prompt band mod toasts the same).

showPomodoro.title: Pomodoro
showPomodoro.description: A 25/5 pomodoro, kept in the plugin store so a round survives /exit.

pomodoroLength.title: Pomodoro length
pomodoroLength.description: Focus and break in minutes; the long break after every fourth round is 15 (25/5) or 30 minutes.

pomodoroSound.title: Pomodoro sound
pomodoroSound.description: A sound and the terminal bell when a round ends. Off: only the toast and a silent macOS notification.

showSpotify.title: Music player
showSpotify.description: The track playing in Spotify or Apple Music under Now, with prev/play/pause/next, read over osascript while the panel is open.

musicPlayer.title: Music app
musicPlayer.description: Which app the music player reads. auto: Spotify and Apple Music, the one playing wins.

showPrs.title: My PRs
showPrs.description: Your open pull requests, every five minutes, from the PR sources.

showReviewPrs.title: Other PRs
showReviewPrs.description: The pull requests you review, from the same read as My PRs. With both off no source is asked.

prSource.title: PR sources
prSource.description: auto: GitHub through gh, GitLab through glab and Bitbucket Data Center through an MCP server, whichever this machine has. Or only the one named.

githubHost.title: GitHub host
githubHost.description: Empty for github.com; a GitHub Enterprise host (github.example.com) otherwise. gh must be logged in to it.

gitlabHost.title: GitLab host
gitlabHost.description: Empty: the host glab is logged in to (gitlab.com by default); a self-managed host (gitlab.example.com) otherwise.

showTickets.title: Ticket list
showTickets.description: Your open tickets, every five minutes, from the ticket sources.

ticketSource.title: Ticket sources
ticketSource.description: auto: Jira and Linear through their MCP servers, GitHub and GitLab issues through gh and glab, whichever this machine has. Or only the one named.

jiraSite.title: Jira site
jiraSite.description: Your Atlassian site (example.atlassian.net). Empty: the first site the Atlassian server can reach.

jiraQuery.title: Jira query
jiraQuery.description: The JQL of the Jira list. Empty: your open tickets, the latest first.

showMail.title: Mail and calendar
showMail.description: Unread mail and the next meetings, from an MCP server that has list_recent_emails and list_calendar_events (README, Mail). Off by default.

showSessions.title: Claude sessions
showSessions.description: The other Claude Code windows on this machine, while any runs; read while the panel is open.

showSessionCommands.title: Catchup, Wrapup, Clear
showSessionCommands.description: The three session buttons under the context meter.

catchupCommand.title: Catchup command
catchupCommand.description: The command the Catchup button runs. Empty: Pelyar's own /pelyar:catchup. Or any command of the session, by its name (workflow:catchup, or catchup).

wrapupCommand.title: Wrapup command
wrapupCommand.description: The command the Wrapup button and the context nudge use. Empty: Pelyar's own /pelyar:wrapup. Or any command of the session, by its name.

wrapupCommit.title: Wrapup commits
wrapupCommit.description: Pelyar's own wrapup commits CLAUDE.md and new records when CLAUDE.md is tracked in git. Off: it only writes them.

showModel.title: Model and effort
showModel.description: The Model section with its chips and the 1-9 hotkeys.

showTodos.title: Todo list
showTodos.description: The todo list under Work; off, the todo file is not read.

showCommands.title: Work commands
showCommands.description: Review changes, Review a PR, Security review and your pinned commands under Work. With the todo list also off, Work is left out.

showTeam.title: Team skills
showTeam.description: The Team section with your team plugin's skills (<prefix><team>, the team from git config user.team). Off by default; off, the team is not read.

teamPrefix.title: Team plugin prefix
teamPrefix.description: Team plugins are named <prefix><team>: with team- and user.team "Platform Tools", the plugin team-platform-tools. Empty: team-.

teamMarketplace.title: Team marketplace
teamMarketplace.description: The marketplace the install hint names (/plugin install <plugin>@<marketplace>). An installed team plugin is found from any marketplace.
